name: Vorgol
verdict: Russian natural-water brand sold by its exclusive distributor OOO «Дабл Блэк», whose registry-listed owner is an individual, Evgeny Kuprin. No state in the chain and no human-rights finding found.
note: Artesian drinking-water brand from the Lipetsk region; official supplier of FC Rodina's professional teams and academy since 25 Jul 2026. The brand-to-company link is the distributor relation stated on vorgolmsk.ru (the brand's site is OOO «Дабл Блэк»'s); the registry masks Dabl Blek's share data, so the exact stake is not published.
